brief:
Spain's prime minister Pedro Sánchez condemned Israel for genocide in Gaza during his address to the United Nations General Assembly, Middle East Eye reported. Sánchez's remarks marked a direct accusation against Israeli military operations in the territory.

The Spanish leader's statement at the UN forum represents a significant diplomatic intervention on the Gaza conflict by a major European Union member state.
dek: Spain's prime minister slams Israel’s genocide in Gaza during UN speech Spanish prime minister Pedro Sanchez has condemned Israel for its genocide in Gaza during his address to the United Nations General Assembly.
title: Spain's PM condemns Israel's genocide in Gaza at UN
